title: Preparation, characterization, and antioxidant activity of gallic acid grafted purple sweet potato polysaccharide
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41850-41855
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05142H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenting Zhang, Jian Sun, Ruixue Yue, Yi Zhang, Hong Zhu, Chen Ma, Shaoying Deng, Hao Guo
Alkali-soluble purple sweet potato polysaccharide (PSAP) was conjugated with gallic acid (GA) through a free radical grafting reaction. The conjugate's structure was validated and it exhibited stronger antioxidant activity than native PSAP.
